text:
alice_k: Starting staged rollout for inference-api v2.3.1 -> eu-west1. Rolling 5% now, target 15% after 10m checks.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout-id r-20260321-51 started by alice_k
```
redwoodctl rollout status r-20260321-51
stage: canary
traffic: 5%
version: v2.3.1
```
ben_s: Watching latency and error budget. Can we hold at 5% for 12m? quick check on p50/p95 please.
ops_sre: p50 +2ms, p95 +10ms, errors +0.15pp (baseline 0.6% -> 0.75%). KVcache OOMs: 3 in last 5m across 2 hosts.
jordan_pm: Hold til SRE gives green or we see no OOM trend for next 5m. :hourglass: 
carla-m: I'm +1 for hold. If it keeps, we should pin back to v2.3.0. Ben can you prepare rollback play?
ben_s: prep ready. rollback command:
```
redwoodctl rollback --service inference-api --to v2.3.0 --force-offline=false
```
ben_s: also pin command if we need hard-pin:
`redwoodctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.0 --note "rollback after canary OOMs"`
deploy-bot: [metric-hook] 5123456800 p95 latency spike detected for r-20260321-51, alert: metric.p95 > 200ms (current 212ms)
ops_sre: Confirming: spike tied to two gpu nodes with older driver causing mem pressure. Tentative action: stop rollout and divert traffic to reserved capacity.
alice_k: Stop. Pausing ramp. Holding at 5% and pinning traffic to v2.3.0 while SRE remediates. @deploy-bot please abort further traffic shift.
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout r-20260321-51 paused by alice_k
jordan_pm: Noting change window update: pause at 5% until 2026-03-21T15:40Z. Ops to post update when cleared. :white_check_mark:
carla-m: Thanks team. Ben, execute pin if OOMs continue; otherwise we'll resume ramp after greencheck.
ben_s: Acknowledged. Standing by. :thumbsup:
ops_sre: Will post remediation progress in 5m.
